reference_scope: All tracked repository text, including tools, generated proof tables, and build metadata. Allocation paths, generated ISA traces, machine dumps/binaries, stock inventory and CFG excluded before reading.
reference_limits: Lexical occurrences include historical metadata and comments. Parsed local Require edges give transitive consumers. No compiled dependency or removal test ran.
replacement_policy: Each reference has an exact keyed lemma/registration target where available, or an explicit retained/nothing status. R1/R4 consumers and R3 API remain pending. E3 stays separate.
checks: Exact Git blob hashes, lines, symbols, and replacement-status coverage passed. Metadata only.
